***We are delighted that you are planning to attend a residential retreat here at Spirit Rock Meditation Center. Attached are the registration forms for this retreat. Financial aid information is also attached. Please read the following carefully before you send in your registration forms. Please keep this document for your reference.***
**About the Retreat Spirit Rock Meditation Center is dedicated to** the teachings of the Buddha as presented in the Theravadan vipassana tradition. The practice of mindful awareness, called Insight or Vipassana Meditation, is at the heart of all the activities at Spirit Rock. A residential retreat begins with the taking of the precepts for non-harm to all beings.
Retreats are conducted in silence, which includes no talking, no listening to music, no reading and no writing except for notes recording your meditation experience. However, there are daily dharma talks and instruction in meditation as well as opportunities to discuss the practice with the teacher through individual consultations or group discussions.
All retreatants are expected to attend the full retreat.
A typical retreat day begins at approximately 5 a.m. and ends at approximately 10 p.m. The whole day is spent practicing sitting and walking meditation, cultivating continuous attention to the changing nature of our moment-to-moment experience.
In addition, meditators will be assigned a daily job to assist with the running of the retreat. This work is a part of the practice.
**Accommodations and Food**
The wooded campus includes separate buildings for dining, meeting, and sleeping.
Spirit Rock has two-story residence buildings with single and double rooms. Spirit Rock’s maximum capacity is approximately 85 retreatants. No camping is allowed. Sometimes there are two retreats on campus at the same time.
Room assignments are made by the Retreat Managers before the retreat starts. Because of the high demand for single rooms, we cannot guarantee a single room to anyone. We ask that you graciously accept the room you are assigned.
There is a 20% slope from the dining room to the residences and to the meditation hall. Please note any medical problems or limited mobility on the registration form in order for the managers to provide for your full participation. We have personal scooters available if the steep hill is a
problem for you. Please let us know ahead of time if you’ll need one.
Nutritious, balanced vegetarian meals are served during retreat. Should you have medical dietary restrictions, the cooks will take your information at the retreat when you check in.
**Special Request**
In consideration of all participants, please do not wear scented personal care products to Spirit Rock (including “natural” products). This is part of our policy because those who are allergic to scented products cannot attend if others are wearing them.
**Retreat Costs**
Spirit Rock Meditation Center is a non-profit organization with retreat costs covered by sliding scale fees. Please pay at the highest level of the sliding scale that you can afford. This allows others who need to pay less the opportunity to attend. Whatever you pay above the lowest end of the sliding scale is a tax-deductible donation to Spirit Rock.
*DANA: Retreat registration fees cover only our* expenses in running the retreat. None of this money goes directly to the teachers or residential retreat staff, cooks and retreat managers. Their ability to continue offering these retreats depends solely on donations from retreat participants.
This tradition of making an offering to those who *make this retreat possible is called Dana, which* is the Pali (the language of the Buddha) word for generosity. According to the Buddha, generosity, or sharing what we have, is one of the central pillars of a spiritual life. So we encourage students to make an offering to teachers and retreat staff in addition to the registration fees. This opportunity is given at the end of the retreat and can be paid by cash, check, credit card, or deferred payment and is a tax-deductible contribution.
After the retreat, we will provide you with a *letter acknowledging your dana contribution,* any amount paid over the lower end of the sliding scale, and/or any scholarship donations sent with your registration form.
If you are unable to attend a retreat due to financial circumstances, scholarships are available. Please refer to Guide to Financial Assistance for Spirit Rock Residential Retreats, which is attached.
**How to sign up for a retreat**
You will need to complete the registration forms and send them to SRMC, with the required deposit to hold your place. The required deposit is listed on your registration form.
The registration forms are different for each retreat, so please make sure you send in the forms for the retreat you’re interested in. If you would like to register more than one person, we require separate registration forms and payment for each person.
If you register for more than one retreat at a time, please send in a separate payment and registration forms for each retreat.
*Please help us keep our administrative costs low by paying the entire fee with your registration, if* ***possible. If this is not possible, the balance is*** payable 10 days before the retreat.
We accept Visa and MasterCard, checks, and cash. All payments must be submitted in US funds.
*Early application is suggested, as accommodations are limited.*
Please note that all deferred payment plans must be paid off or you must make special arrangements with Spirit Rock Meditation Center regarding any outstanding balances before you can register.
A few of our retreats have pre-requisites. The registration form will state the pre-requisite if one exists.
Any requests for early departures or late arrivals need to be approved by the teachers before you can register for the retreat. Please know that if you receive such approval you will still need to pay for the entire retreat.
*Scholarships: If you are applying for a* scholarship, send in the registration form with a deposit, following the instructions, to secure your place in the retreat. On the registration form please indicate which scholarship form you need, and it will be sent to you with your confirmation
(People of Color scholarships are arranged over the phone, so if you’d like to apply, please call 415.488.0164 ext. 237). Before you can apply for a scholarship, you must register and have a confirmed spot in the retreat.
*Confirmation: Once we process your registration* form and deposit, a confirmation will be sent to you along with other useful information such as what to bring, etc. A scholarship form will also be included if you have indicated you would like to apply.
Confirmation letters are sent via email, unless you indicate that you would like the letters and information mailed to you. If you have not been contacted after two weeks please call or email to make sure your forms were received.
*Waiting list: If the retreat if full, we will put you* on a waiting list to be notified in case we have any cancellations.
**Cancellation fees**
Please give us as much notice as possible if you need to cancel your place in the retreat, so that we can offer your place to another retreatant.
Fees and payments for a retreat cannot be transferred to another retreat or to another person.
Cancellation fees vary slightly per retreat. Cancellation fees increase as the opening date approaches. There is no refund as of opening day. See the top of registration form for the retreat you are applying for exact amount and dates the fees take effect.
*No refund will be given if a retreatant leaves a* retreat early or arrives late. Out of consideration for others on the waiting list, who could have done the retreat in your place, as well as for yourself, please make a commitment to attend **the whole retreat.**
*Thank you for taking the time to read this. For more information, please visit our web site www.SpiritRock.org, email us at retreats@spiritrock.org, or call the info line for the retreat you are interested in attending. Please note the Frequently Asked Questions on our web site.*
*Thank you and namaste, the Registrars*
**Please keep this sheet for your reference.**
**Travel Information**
**Spirit Rock is located at 5000 Sir Francis Drake Blvd in Woodacre, west Marin, California, 45 minutes north of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco.**
**Driving From San Francisco, take 101 North, across the Golden Gate Bridge,** Take the Sir Francis Drake/San Anselmo exit off 101 in Larkspur. Stay on Sir Francis Drake for the next 10 miles, Spirit Rock is at 5000 Sir Francis Drake Blvd, it is a right turn off the road. There is a sign at the entrance.
**From the East Bay, take the Sir Francis Drake exit off 580 immediately after crossing the Richmond/San Rafael Bridge.** Stay on Sir Francis Drake for the next 10 miles, Spirit Rock is at 5000 Sir Francis Drake Blvd, it is a right turn off the road. There is a sign at the entrance. We are situated on a 400-acre nature preserve.
**Getting to the Retreat by Airplane** Spirit Rock is easily accessible from both the Oakland and San Francisco International Airports. Please allow 2 to 3 hours to get from the airport to Spirit Rock.
**From the San Francisco Airport: The Marin Airporter (415.461.4222) bus transports passengers between the** San Francisco airport and the San Rafael bus station\*. The Marin Door to Door (415.457.2717) bus can take you from the San Francisco airport directly to Spirit Rock.
**From the Oakland Airport: The Sonoma County Airport Express (707.837.8700) transports passengers between** the Oakland Airport and the San Rafael bus station\*. The Marin Door to Door (415.457.2717) bus can take you from the Oakland airport directly to Spirit Rock.
Please call the bus companies for a current schedule and prices.
***From the San Rafael bus station: You can take a cab from here to Spirit Rock. Cabs cost approximately $25-** $30 (subject to change). From the bus station, it is a 20-25 minute cab ride to Spirit Rock. Cabs are usually waiting at the bus station, however, between 7.30 and 9am and 1.30 and 3pm each weekday, there are not many cabs available, so you should call ahead and reserve one if you need one during those hours. You can call Marin Happy Cab Company at 415.455.4555 to make a reservation or for more information.
Sometimes local retreatants offer rides from the San Rafael bus terminal to Spirit Rock. If you’d like to try and find a ride, please send an email to retreats@spiritrock.org and request a carpool list for your retreat. We can send you a list once you’re confirmed in the retreat.
**Carpool Arrangements** The registrar will provide you with the names and phone numbers of other retreatants so that you may make carpooling **arrangements. For a list of possible rides, please send an email to retreats@spiritrock.org no earlier than 2 weeks before** the start of the retreat, and the registrar will email you a list of people to call.

   *Dear Yogis,*
   *Spirit Rock Meditation Center is founded on the principles and teachings of the Dharma for the liberation of all beings. It is our goal to offer those teachings as freely as possible and with the greatest possible access to them. However, Spirit Rock exists in the world of modern America, which can include the possibility of claims and litigation against Spirit Rock for what can occur during events on the land. Such claims and litigation when made needlessly or frivolously would be a costly and time-consuming process that could eventually threaten the continued viability of Spirit Rock and our ability to offer access to the Dharma to this community.*
   *Thus, we ask that you read and sign this waiver of liability. By signing it, you will be indicating that you understand that you play a role in protecting the Spirit Rock community’s Meditation Center from litigation.*
   *With metta,*

      Dear Friend,
      If you’ve been sitting at Spirit Rock for any length of time, you’ve probably heard someone say that retreat fees do not cover the actual costs of holding our retreats. Spirit Rock has chosen to keep fees reasonable to allow people to attend retreats who might not otherwise be financially able. The amount of costs covered by retreat fees varies from year to year depending on donor support and scholarship allocations, but it is never enough to cover the entire amount.
      In June 2001, we instituted a sliding scale policy for retreat fees, thus enabling yogis who are capable of paying at the higher end of the scale to help support the practice of those who would find higher fees a financial burden. Many yogis report that this type of generosity becomes a rewarding part of their practice.
      If you have the means, please consider paying a higher amount. Any amount you pay over and above the lower end of the sliding scale qualifies as a tax-deductible contribution, and we will provide you with a letter acknowledging your gift to Spirit Rock after the retreat. You will also receive an acknowledgement letter for *your tax-deductible dana contributions for teacher and retreat staff support. Both* types of support are greatly appreciated.
      If you have any questions about our pricing policies, or any other issues, feel free to contact me at evank@spiritrock.org.
      Sincerely,
      Evan Kavanagh Executive Director Spirit Rock Meditation Center

      **A GUIDE TO FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FOR SPIRIT ROCK RESIDENTIAL RETREATS**
      **IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY, AS THERE HAVE BEEN SOME IMPORTANT CHANGES**
      **NOTE: For non-residential daylongs, classes, or benefits, contact the Spirit Rock Volunteer Coordinator at** 415-488-0164 ext 224 to find out about our work exchange program.

* **Deferred Payment Plan** You can arrange to pay your retreat registration fee over time via monthly deductions from your bank account. Send in your registration forms and deposit (see registration forms for the deposit amount) to the Retreat Registrar and ask for a Deferred Payment Form. Fill out the form, attach a voided blank check, bring it with you to the retreat, and give it to the retreat manager when you check in. You may, if necessary, **combine this plan with any of the other three plans. IMPORTANT: If you have any outstanding balances due to Spirit Rock, they must be paid off before registering for another retreat. Deferred** payment is also available for Teacher and Staff Dana at the end of a retreat. Please bring an extra voided check if you'd like to defer your teacher and staff dana.
  *Please choose only ONE of the following scholarship options. These can be combined with a deferred payment plan if necessary.*
* **The Mudita/Karuna Scholarship Fund** ***If financial difficulties prevent you from attending a retreat, apply to the Mudita Scholarship Fund. If you*** have a life-threatening illness and your medical expenses prevent you from affording the retreat, apply to ***the Karuna Scholarship Fund. If you would like to apply for either of these scholarships, ask the Retreat Registrar for the Mudita/Karuna Scholarship Fund form. Please read the guidelines carefully before*** applying.
  *If you are applying for the Mudita Scholarship, send a minimum deposit of $10 per night (for example, send* a $70 deposit for a 7-night retreat) to the Retreat Registrar along with your registration forms in order to *secure your spot in the retreat. If you are applying for the Karuna Scholarship, no deposit is required.* Indicate on your registration form that you would like a Mudita/Karuna scholarship form, and one will be sent to you with your retreat confirmation. Before your scholarship application can be processed, you need to be confirmed in the retreat.
  Maximum allowable allocation in a 12-month period for each Mudita applicant is $500 (Additional scholarship monies available to those registering for 4-8 week retreats). There is no limit for Karuna ***applicants. The deadline for Mudita applications is four weeks before the retreat. Applications received*** after that date are considered subject to availability of funds. Applications received less than one week ***before the retreat will not be considered. There is no deadline for Karuna applications.***
  Please send your ***Mudita/Karuna application to the scholarship administrator listed at the bottom of that*** form.
* **The People of Color Scholarship Fund** This scholarship fund is specifically for non-Caucasians. Spirit Rock actively seeks and supports diversity.
  To apply for the scholarship call 415-488-0164 ext 237. This line will give you detailed information about the deposit required for your registration.
  *Our intention at Spirit Rock is to make residential retreats available to as many as we can. We do everything we can to keep costs low and at the same time, we must work with the financial realities of basic expenses and limited funds.*
